violations.detail: Plan promises "hypertrophy" but duration is 2wk — that adaptation is not physiologically deliverable in this window.
Maintenance block; week 2 volume 119 is >10% above week 1 (93). Maintenance should not progress.

PLAN "Travel Maintenance — Hotel Room Hypertrophy Hold"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary hypertrophy:
    name "Maintain muscle mass during 2-week travel block"

PHASES
  PHASE "Travel Maintenance" (2 weeks):

      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Pull Focus":

          cat_cow 1m

          pull_up 4x5..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
